name: silence-detector
title: silence-detector
description: Detect initial silence segments in audio/video using energy-based analysis. Use when you need to find low-energy periods at the start of recordings (title slides, setup time, pre-roll silence).

related_skills.name: energy-calculator
related_skills.reason: Initial silence detection analyzes pre-computed energy data; it is a narrower application of energy profiling.

related_skills.name: pause-detector
related_skills.reason: Initial-silence detection is a narrower case; pause-detector finds silence/pauses throughout audio, not just at the start.

related_skills.name: Voice Activity Detection (VAD)
related_skills.reason: Silence-detector is narrower: it detects only initial low-energy silence, while VAD detects speech/silence segments more generally.
